newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Free Record Shop expands in Norway.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Free Record Shop expands in Norway.

text.p: Recorded music retailer Free Record Shop Holding NV said on Tuesday it would open an outlet in the Norwegian university town of Tromsoe this week, the Dutch group's first shop within the Arctic Circle.
The shop is Free Record Shop's tenth in Norway. Its first Norwegian outlet started business only two years ago.

Next week it will open another branch in the town of Bodoe and one in the city of Bergen. Later this month Free Record Shop Norway A.S. will open three small shops in the airports of Stavanger, Bodoe and Kristiansand.
